# A transaction whose split states its guid with `split_guid:`, the key's old
# name.
#
# A split states its guid with `guid:`, as every other block does. Read as a
# custom key, `split_guid:` would be stored on the split while GnuCash assigned
# the split a new guid, so the import refuses it and says the new name.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The import refuses the transaction.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_the_old_split_guid_key_is_refused.py.
2026-01-15 * "Cash sale"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 100.00 CAD
		split_guid: "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Income:Sales -100.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
